Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lake Wales for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (the Christmas Tree Lighting at City Hall) through December 19, with Make It Magical at Downtown Market Plaza (December 11), the Lake Wales Christmas Parade (December 12), Santa's Toy Bag Workshop at Bok Tower Gardens (December 16) and Christmas Cinema with Santa at Oakley Park (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Lake Wales

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Lake Wales

  • Parades and tree lightings: Christmas Tree Lighting at City Hall (December 1) and Lake Wales Christmas Parade (December 12)
  • Trains: train rides at Christmas Cinema with Santa at Oakley Park (December 19)
  • Season: December 1 to December 19
